topics.title: Uncomfortable Underwear and Wrestling Interviews
topics.summary: A man recounts his mother's detailed inspection process for soiled underwear, including soaping and soaking. The conversation shifts to an awkward radio interview with Mike Tyson featuring inappropriate questions about wrestling’s perceived homosexuality and a CBS broadcast filled with unprofessional commentary.

topics.title: Radio Hosts Discuss Villains and Wrestling
topics.summary: During a radio segment, callers discuss Village People’s attire and wrestlers engaging in mock fights. Concerns arise regarding Vince McMahon allegations, followed by personal questions involving Monica Lewinsky and opinions on racial stereotypes, culminating in inappropriate comments about sexual relationships.

topics.title: Racial Remarks and Wrestling Questions
topics.summary: During a press conference featuring Mike Tyson, participants engaged in racially charged comments regarding skin color and heritage. Discussions extended to wrestling techniques, potential opponents, and interpretations of Tyson's statements, including debates over terms like 'intuitiveness' and the use of racial slurs.

topics.title: Clinton Birthday & Lewinsky Investigation
topics.summary: During a state dinner celebrating President Clinton’s birthday, discussions arose about the ongoing investigation into his relationship with Monica Lewinsky and allegations of inappropriate behavior involving WWF wrestlers. Elton John performed while debates centered on renaming an airport after Reagan due to Alzheimer's disease.

topics.title: Lewinsky Testimony Dispute and Celebrity News
topics.summary: Kenneth Starr demands Monica Lewinsky provide all information, threatening no immunity if she doesn’t meet face-to-face; Bill Clinton believes Lewinsky is willing to admit an affair while Starr focuses on her refusal to acknowledge President Clinton's involvement. Simultaneously, Rob Halford publicly announces his sexuality and Mike Tyson denies severing ties with associates, alongside news about Donald Trump considering selling his Atlantic City casinos.

topics.title: Lee Tape Saga and Movie Releases
topics.summary: The broadcast details the ongoing legal battle surrounding Pamela Anderson Lee’s sex tape with Brett Michaels, focusing on claims of only three copies existing. It then shifts to reviews of new movie releases including ‘Replacement Killers,’ featuring Chow Yun-Fat, and a look at Dennis Rodman's film debut alongside Dee Wallace Stone, concluding with coverage of Gilbert Gottfried’s TV appearances.
